Crime Analytics with SQL

MySQL project analyzing incident categories, crime timing, long-term felony backlog, financial loss, district context and vehicle-theft locations.

Finding: Property crime represented 57.77% of incidents, Assault had the largest 12+ month felony backlog at 797 cases, and Theft generated about $3.99M in recorded loss.

About

Computer Science graduate with a Data Science concentration, practical analytics projects, and operations experience that helps me connect data to how work actually gets done.

I came to Canada in 2019 and completed a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at Ontario Tech University in 2025, with a concentration in Data Science. Coursework in databases, statistics, machine learning and information visualization gave me the technical foundation for analytics.

I have built projects with retail sales, customer, shipping, economic and movie datasets using SQL, Power BI, Excel, Python and R. I enjoy the full workflow: checking data quality, asking business questions, finding patterns and turning the results into clear dashboards or recommendations.

My experience at Loblaws and Estée Lauder also exposed me to inventory, product quality, material movement, purchase orders and SAP. I am now looking for a Data Analyst opportunity where I can combine technical analysis with practical business understanding.
